#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Research Directors (RD)
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a RD given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The RD is required to keep a written log of all active anomalies. If an anomaly poses immediate threat or danger to the crew, it is required to be eliminated.
[bold]2.[/bold] The RD must perform research. If research is not able to be performed, the Captain will be contacted for assistant on next steps.
[bold]3.[/bold] The RD [bold]must[/bold] use an artifact container to transport dangerous artifacts outside of their department.
[bold]4.[/bold] The RD is allowed to change the Station AIs laws given approval from the Captain.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The RD is permitted to have on their person, a single weapon created in the Protolathe, with the express permission from the Head of Security.
